Description & Normalization Rule: Deterministic hash of isin (or normalized_name) + effective_delisting_date + delisting_type.
Official legal name as stated in the NSE circular/order.
Historical NSE ticker symbol (uppercase, trimmed; UNKNOWN if unavailable).
12-character ISIN (INE...), primary identifier for cross-year deduplication.
One of: COMPULSORY, VOLUNTARY_EXIT_OFFER, VOLUNTARY_NO_EXIT, AMALGAMATION_MERGER, IBC_NCLT, OTHER.
Date of Delisting Committee order or exchange approval notice (null if N/A).
Date equity shares ceased to be listed/traded on NSE.
4-digit year derived from effective_delisting_date (fallback to order_date).
Indian FY format (e.g., FY2017-18 for dates between 2017-04-01 and 2018-03-31).
true if calendar_year or order_date year is in {2007, 2017, 2020, 2024}, else false.
Applicable framework (e.g., SEBI_2003_Guidelines, SEBI_2009_Regs, SEBI_2021_Regs, SEBI_2024_Amendment).
Exit price (voluntary) or independent valuer fair value (compulsory) in INR, if disclosed.
Exact URL where the primary document/circular was discovered or retrieved.
Relative path in data/raw/ to the cached circular/sheet/page backing the row.
VERIFIED_PRIMARY (official NSE/SEBI circular/list), CORROBORATED_SECONDARY (reputable financial/legal archive), or NEEDS_REVIEW.
